connector.name: MCP Cn Commerce
connector.registryDescription: Read-only merchant data from 8 Chinese e-commerce platforms: orders, products, after-sales, ads
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package mcp-cn-commerce. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the tonywang-hub account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
